sections.title: The for Loop
sections.content:
In bash_loops, greet Alice/Bob/Charlie/David and iterate numbers 1–5.

`~/project/bash_loops/for_loop.sh`:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
NAMES=(Alice Bob Charlie David)
for name in "${NAMES[@]}"; do echo "Hello, $name!"; done
for i in {1..5}; do echo "Number: $i"; done
```

Run:

```bash
chmod +x ~/project/bash_loops/for_loop.sh
~/project/bash_loops/for_loop.sh 
```

verification.command:
python3 - <<'LABEX_CHECK'
import os,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,tempfile
p=pathlib.Path('/home/labex/project/bash_loops/for_loop.sh')
assert p.is_file(), 'Create the requested file first'
text=p.read_text()
assert all(token in text for token in ['for ', '${NAMES[@]}']), 'Required concepts missing'
if True: assert os.access(p,os.X_OK), 'Add execute permission'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='labex-shell-check-') as directory:
    work=pathlib.Path(directory)
    source=p
    if p.suffix == '.sh':
        p=work/source.name
        # Preserve teaching delays in the learner file; suppress sleep only in
        # this isolated behavior probe so a five-second loop does not time out.
        p.write_text(text if False else text.replace('sleep 1', ':').replace('sleep 2', ':'))
        p.chmod(0o700)
        assert subprocess.run(['/bin/bash','-n',str(p)],capture_output=True).returncode == 0
    def execute(arguments, data=''):
        return subprocess.run(['/bin/bash',*arguments],input=data,text=True,capture_output=True,cwd=work,timeout=2)
    result=execute([str(p),*[]],'')
    assert all(item in result.stdout for item in ['Hello, Alice!', 'Hello, David!', 'Number: 1', 'Number: 5']),result.stdout
LABEX_CHECK

sections.title: The while Loop
sections.content:
Count down 5→1 using while, pause one second, then announce launch.

`~/project/bash_loops/while_loop.sh`:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
count=5
echo "Countdown:"
while [ "$count" -gt 0 ]; do
  echo "$count"
  count=$((count - 1))
  sleep 1
done
echo "Blast off!"
```

Run:

```bash
chmod +x ~/project/bash_loops/while_loop.sh
~/project/bash_loops/while_loop.sh 
```

Dùng while đếm ngược 5→1, nghỉ mỗi giây rồi thông báo phóng.

sections.title: The until Loop
sections.content:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
count=1
echo "Counting up to 5:"
until [ "$count" -gt 5 ]; do

  sleep 1
done
```

sections.title: Using break and continue Statements
sections.content:
Break at 6; use continue in a second loop to print odd numbers through 9.

`~/project/bash_loops/break_continue.sh`:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
echo "Demonstration of break:"
for i in {1..10}; do
  if [ "$i" -eq 6 ]; then echo "Breaking the loop at $i"; break; fi
  echo "$i"
done
echo "Demonstration of continue (printing odd numbers):"
for i in {1..10}; do
  if [ $((i % 2)) -eq 0 ]; then continue; fi
  echo "$i"
done
```

Run:

```bash
chmod +x ~/project/bash_loops/break_continue.sh
~/project/bash_loops/break_continue.sh 
```
